What is Aegisora?

Aegisora is a Python and TypeScript framework that acts as a Cryptographic Runtime Firewall for Large Language Models (LLMs). It intercepts inputs and outputs in milliseconds to enforce strict governance policies.

  • Runs Input/Output Guards in your application to detect, quantify, and mitigate risks (e.g., PII Leakage, SQL Injection, Toxicity).
  • Validates structured JSON data generated by LLMs to ensure pipeline stability.
  • Provides cryptographic audit trails for compliance (SOC 2, ISO 26262).
